content: In-process feature-flag pattern for no-restart toggling: simple in-memory dict/singleton holding flag states, mutated via an admin HTTP endpoint (e.g. POST /admin/flags/{name}), read synchronously by request-handling code paths on every request. No external flag service needed for a single-process demo. Caveat: toggling mid-request can cause inconsistent state across concurrent requests -- acceptable for a demo scenario but worth a comment in code.
